question_vi: GraalVM Native Image với Spring Boot 3 hoạt động thế nào? Ưu/nhược điểm?
question_en: How does GraalVM Native Image work with Spring Boot 3? What are the pros and cons?
answer_vi:
**GraalVM Native Image** compile Java app thành native executable — không cần JVM lúc chạy. Build bằng `native-maven-plugin`: `mvn -Pnative native:compile` (cần GraalVM) hoặc `mvn -Pnative spring-boot:build-image` (native Docker image, không cần cài GraalVM).

| | JVM | Native |
|---|---|---|
| Startup | ~2-5s | ~50-200ms |
| Memory (RSS) | ~300MB | ~50-80MB |
| Throughput | Cao (JIT) | Thấp hơn ~10-20% |
| Build time | ~30s | 3-10 phút |

**Cơ chế — AOT:** Spring Boot 3 phân tích app lúc build, sinh reflection metadata; Native Image compile thành binary. **Closed-world:** mọi code phải biết trước lúc compile.

**Hạn chế:** reflection phải khai báo (thư viện ngoài đôi khi cần `reflect-config.json`); dynamic proxy/CGLIB giới hạn; classpath scanning không chạy runtime; build chậm.

**Dùng khi:** serverless/AWS Lambda (cold start), CLI (Spring Shell), microservice cần startup nhanh + memory thấp. **KHÔNG dùng khi:** cần throughput cao (native kém JIT ~10-20% sau warmup), dùng nhiều lib chưa hỗ trợ GraalVM, team chưa quen debug native
answer_en:
**GraalVM Native Image** compiles a Java app into a native executable — no JVM at runtime. Build with `native-maven-plugin`: `mvn -Pnative native:compile` (needs GraalVM) or `mvn -Pnative spring-boot:build-image` (native Docker image, no GraalVM install).

| | JVM | Native |
|---|---|---|
| Startup | ~2-5s | ~50-200ms |
| Memory (RSS) | ~300MB | ~50-80MB |
| Throughput | High (JIT) | ~10-20% lower |
| Build time | ~30s | 3-10 minutes |

**Mechanism — AOT:** Spring Boot 3 analyzes the app at build time and generates reflection metadata; Native Image compiles it into a binary. **Closed-world:** all code must be known at compile time.

**Limitations:** reflection must be declared (third-party libs may need `reflect-config.json`); dynamic proxies/CGLIB are limited; classpath scanning does not run at runtime; slow builds.

**Use when:** serverless/AWS Lambda (cold start), CLIs (Spring Shell), microservices needing fast startup + low memory. **Do NOT use when:** you need maximum throughput (native is ~10-20% slower than JIT after warmup), you rely on libs without GraalVM support, or the team lacks native-debugging experience
